A security update for Nix: the Nix package of Lucid is now built with Go 1.26.10 instead of 1.26.8, which fixes security issues in Go's standard library, among them denial-of-service issues in the HTTP server and compromised certificates that TLS connections no longer trust.

Lucid itself and its settings are unchanged.

## Upgrading

With Nix, `nix flake update` brings 0.1.1 if you follow `github:tbckr/lucid/stable`; if you use a release tag, switch to `github:tbckr/lucid/v0.1.1`.
